main_result: Every radial scalar-convolution POVM for a Clifford tuple is a state-independent garbling of an efficiently compiled spherical projective POVM. Every scalar regularizer, radial or not, sees only the Clifford spin vector and misses orthogonal states with opposite controlled response.

claims.statement: Exact outcome-law equality has precisely the same state fibers as the full characteristic family exp(iA(t)); scalar characteristic-function zeros do not enlarge the fibers for bounded A.
claims.dependency: bounded operators; probability scalar noise; exact positive contract

claims.statement: Radial Clifford regularizer M is Blackwell-dominated by spherical N; equivalence iff E eta^2=1.
claims.dependency: Clifford relations; radial scalar noise; exact positive contract

claims.statement: For m>=4, rho_plus/minus=(I +/- i Gamma1 Gamma2)/d are orthogonal and M-indistinguishable but have opposite Gamma1 response to exp(-i theta Gamma2/2).
claims.dependency: Clifford relations; any scalar noise; exact contract

claims.statement: Center Fisher information is E eta^2 I/m and chi-squared testing divergence is h^2 E eta^2/m.
claims.dependency: radial polar representation; spin-factor local model

claims.statement: Radial covariance v strictly exceeds (m-1)a^2 for m>1 under finite third moments. Equality contradicts third directional operator moments.
claims.dependency: radial exact contract; finite third moments; a>0

claims.statement: For fixed m,a,c, the source smooth family has E eta_L^2 ~ m c a^2/L and center Fisher information ~ c a^2 I/L.
claims.dependency: source uniform relative operator error bounded C/L; not independently re-audited

claims.statement: Canonical m-generator Clifford spherical comparator compiles with m-1 adjacent local rotations and one X1 measurement; an ordinary random-coordinate comparator achieves the same mean-estimation second moments using local Pauli readouts.
claims.dependency: qubit encoding; available local rotation control; supplied states; calibrated measurement
